faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about microinsurance on Ingoboka.
faq.a1: Microinsurance offers affordable, simple cover with low premiums and clear benefits — designed for people who may not have traditional insurance. Ingoboka brings these products to your phone.
faq.a2: After choosing a plan, pay your monthly premium with MTN MoMo or Airtel Money directly from the app. No bank account is required.
faq.a3: Open your policy in the app, tap New claim, describe what happened, and upload any required documents. You can track review status from your dashboard.
faq.a4: Yes. We follow Rwanda's data protection law, use secure connections, and only collect what is needed to provide insurance services. You give explicit consent during registration.
faq.a5: Rwandan residents aged 18 and over can register. Some products allow adding dependants such as children or spouses. Agents can also help enroll clients in the field.
faq.a6: Yes. Many plans let you add dependants such as children and spouses. You manage dependants from your citizen dashboard after enrolling.
faq.q7: What if I miss a premium payment?
faq.a7: We send reminders before your due date. If a payment is missed, your policy may enter a grace period. Check your policy terms or contact support for help catching up.
faq.q8: How do I verify a policy?
faq.a8: Each digital policy card includes a QR code. Anyone can scan it to confirm the policy is valid without seeing personal details.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: Ingoboka ("we", "us") operates a digital microinsurance platform in Rwanda. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our website and mobile services.
intro.p2: By using Ingoboka, you agree to the practices described in this policy. We encourage you to read it carefully and contact us if you have questions.

data.title: Data we collect
data.p1: We collect information you provide during registration and use of our services, including your name, phone number, email address, national ID (where required for insurance), dependant details, policy information, claim documents, and payment records via Mobile Money.
data.p2: We also collect technical data such as device type, browser, IP address, and usage logs to keep the platform secure and improve our services.

law.title: Legal basis — Law 058/2021
law.p1: We process personal data in accordance with Rwanda Law No. 058/2021 relating to the protection of personal data and privacy. This includes obtaining your explicit consent where required, processing data only for specified purposes, and respecting your rights as a data subject.
law.p2: Insurance-related data may also be processed to fulfil contractual obligations with licensed insurer partners who underwrite the products offered on our platform.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: Under applicable law, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, withdraw consent, object to certain processing, and request data portability where technically feasible.
rights.p2: To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@ingoboka.rw. We will respond within the timeframe required by law.

security.title: Security
security.p1: We use encryption, access controls, and secure infrastructure to protect your data. While no system is completely immune to risk, we continuously review our security practices.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: For privacy-related enquiries, email hello@ingoboka.rw or write to Ingoboka, Kigali, Rwanda.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.p1: By accessing or using the Ingoboka platform, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

services.title: Our services
services.p1: Ingoboka provides a digital platform to browse, enroll in, and manage microinsurance products offered by licensed insurance partners in Rwanda.
services.p2: We are a technology platform — the insurance contract is between you and the underwriting insurer. Policy terms, coverage, exclusions, and claims decisions are governed by the insurer's policy documents.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.p1: You must provide accurate information when registering. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity on your account.
accounts.p2: You must be at least 18 years old and a resident of Rwanda to register, unless enrolling as a dependant on another member's policy.

payments.title: Payments
payments.p1: Premiums are paid via approved Mobile Money channels. Failure to pay may result in lapse of cover according to your policy terms. All fees and pricing are shown before you confirm enrollment.

claims.title: Claims
claims.p1: Claims submitted through Ingoboka are forwarded to the relevant insurer for assessment. We help you track status but do not make underwriting or claims decisions.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.p1: Ingoboka is provided "as is" to the extent permitted by law. We are not liable for insurer decisions, service interruptions beyond our control, or losses arising from inaccurate information you provide.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after changes are posted constitutes acceptance. Material changes will be communicated via the platform or email.
